info.name: Events Service - My Events (Registrations by Profile)
info.description: GET /api/registrations/profile/:profileId - every registration (event or course) for a profile, enriched with: title, startDate, endDate, venue, format (Virtual/In-Person/Hybrid derived from isVirtual + per-session overrides), eventTypeId + eventTypeName (resolved from user-service Lookup), eventCategoryLookupCode, cpdCredits, accreditationBody, certificationType, imageUrl, deliveryMode (courses), parentStatus (the Event/Course's own Draft/Published/Cancelled/Completed status - distinct from the registration's own pending/confirmed/cancelled status), and registered sessions. Each row also gets a computed `timing` field (past/current/upcoming); pass ?timing= to filter server-side instead of client-side.
